pairs: Audite verbum quod locutus est Dominus super vos,
Listen to the word that the Lord has spoken concerning you,
“Do not choose to learn according to the ways of the Gentiles.
et a signis cæli nolite metuere,
And do not be willing to dread the signs of heaven,
For the laws of the people are empty.
Quia lignum de saltu præcidit opus manus artificis in ascia:
For the work of the hand of the craftsman has cut a tree from the forest with an axe.
He has adorned it with silver and gold.
He has put it together with nail and hammer,
so that it will not fall apart.
They have been fabricated in the likeness of a palm tree,
They must be carried to be moved,
because they do not have the ability to walk.
do not be willing to fear them,
for they can do neither evil nor good.”
there is nothing similar to you.
et magnum nomen tuum in fortitudine.
and your name is great in strength.
Among all the wise of the nations,
there is nothing similar to you.
they will all be proven to be unwise and foolish.
The doctrine of their vanity is made of wood.
Rolled silver is brought from Tarshish, and gold from Uphaz.
et aurum de Ophaz: opus artificis et manus ærarii.
It is the work of a craftsman, and of the hand of a coppersmith.
Hyacinth and purple is their clothing.
All these things are the work of artists.
But the Lord is the true God.
He is the living God and the everlasting King.
et non sustinebunt gentes comminationem ejus.
And the Gentiles will not be able to withstand his threats.
“And so, you shall speak to them in this way:
Dii qui cælos et terram non fecerunt,
The gods that have not made heaven and earth,
pereant de terra et de his quæ sub cælo sunt!
let them perish from the earth and from among those places which are under heaven.
Qui facit terram in fortitudine sua,
He made the earth by his power,
he prepared the world in his wisdom,
and he stretched out the heavens with his understanding.
ad vocem suam dat multitudinem aquarum in cælo,
At his voice, he grants a multitude of waters in the heavens,
et elevat nebulas ab extremitatibus terræ:
and he lifts up the clouds from the ends of the earth.
He causes the lightning with the rain,
et educit ventum de thesauris suis.
and he leads forth the wind from his storehouses.
Stultus factus est omnis homo a scientia:
Every man has become a fool concerning knowledge;
confusus est artifex omnis in sculptili,
every artist has been confounded by his graven image.
For what he has formed is false,
et non est spiritus in eis.
and there is no spirit in these things.
and they are a work deserving of ridicule.
In the time of their visitation, they will perish.
Non est his similis pars Jacob:
Jacob’s portion is not like their portion.
qui enim formavit omnia, ipse est,
For his portion is from the One who formed all things.
And Israel is the staff of his inheritance.
The Lord of hosts is his name.
Gather your shame from the earth,
you who are living under siege.”
Ecce ego longe projiciam habitatores terræ in hac vice,
in this turn, I will cast the inhabitants of the land far away.
et tribulabo eos ita ut inveniantur.
And I will afflict them no matter where they may be found.”
Woe to me, concerning my destruction!
All my cords have been broken.
My sons have gone away from me;
Non est qui extendat ultra tentorium meum,
There is no one to stretch out my tent any more,
nor to set up my curtains.
For the pastors have acted foolishly,
and they have not sought the Lord.
Because of this, they have not understood,
et omnis grex eorum dispersus est.
and all their flock has been dispersed.
et commotio magna de terra aquilonis:
the sound of a voice approaches,
a great commotion from the land of the north:
so that he may make the cities of Judah into a wilderness and into a dwelling place for serpents.
quia non est hominis via ejus,
that the way of man is not his own.
Neither is it given to man to walk
and to direct his own steps.
yet truly, do so with judgment,
ne forte ad nihilum redigas me.
Otherwise, you will reduce me to nothing.
Effunde indignationem tuam super gentes quæ non cognoverunt te,
Pour out your indignation upon the nations that have not known you,
et super provincias quæ nomen tuum non invocaverunt:
and upon the provinces that have not invoked your name.
For they have fed upon Jacob,
and they have utterly destroyed his honor.
